title: Move-Up Measure Against the Next Level's Entry Gate
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — the test for a customer-requested move up.**

### Rule

1. A customer may ask to move a ship-to up; for a ship-to holding Corbett Parcel Ship-To or Corbett Standard Ship-To, and only for such a ship-to, the move up to the next level is decided on the move-up measure against that next level's entry gate, while a ship-to holding Corbett Priority Ship-To or a route level that asks to move up stays under the trailing spend against the higher level's entry gate, a route level also needing a delivery ZIP inside a route territory, and keeps its level under this rule.
2. The next level is Corbett Standard Ship-To for a ship-to holding Corbett Parcel Ship-To, with entry gate 5000.00, and Corbett Priority Ship-To for a ship-to holding Corbett Standard Ship-To, with entry gate 25000.00.
3. The move-up measure is the twelve-month site spend: the extended amount of the ship-to's shipped order lines and backorder fill lines dated within the 12 months before the request date less the credit amount of its received return lines dated within the same 12 months, a line being within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the request date.
4. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.
5. A ship-to whose move-up measure is at or above the next level's entry gate moves up to the next level; a ship-to whose measure is below it keeps its level; the measure and the gate are compared to the cent without rounding.
6. StockSmart replenishment never counts in the move-up measure, program spend not counting toward a ship-to's service level spend, and VendPoint usage does not count in it either.
7. The next level's entry gate is multiplied by every share that applies to it, the shares together in one product, and the move-up measure is compared with that product.

### Level, next level and gate

| Level held | Next level | Entry gate (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | Corbett Standard Ship-To | 5000.00 |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | Corbett Priority Ship-To | 25000.00 |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To or a route level | keeps its level under this rule | not applicable |

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

A ship-to holding Corbett Standard Ship-To has, in the 12 months before the request date, shipped order lines of 23100.00, backorder fills of 2400.00 and received return credits of 500.00.

| Figure | Amount |
|---|---|
| Twelve-month site spend (23100.00 plus 2400.00 less 500.00) | 25000.00 |
| Entry gate of Corbett Priority Ship-To | 25000.00 |
| Result | at the gate: moves up to Corbett Priority Ship-To |

With return credits of 500.01 instead, the measure is 24999.99, below the gate, and the ship-to keeps Corbett Standard Ship-To.
